summary: RemedialFlow iter 17 — security-audit fixes & hardening verified. Added /app/backend/tests/test_security_fixes_iter17.py (27 tests, 100% green against the live preview URL). Covers: (1) SEC-001 CSV/XLSX formula-injection: _safe() escapes '=' '+' '-' '@' '|' '\t' '\r' with a leading apostrophe (unit-tested directly and via live tracker export in both CSV & XLSX formats; no unescaped dangerous cell found). (2) SEC-002 duplicate-earnings race: unique index project_id_1_installer_id_1 confirmed on db.earnings; second direct insert of the same (project_id,installer_id) raises DuplicateKeyError at pymongo level (which settle_earnings in server.py:175 catches). Only one row survives. (3) Content-Security-Policy header: 'default-src \'none\'; frame-ancestors \'none\'; sandbox' present on /api/auth/login, /api/auth/me and even /api/<unknown-404>. Frontend admin+employee login + dashboard + project detail all render fine on 390x844 — CSP is scoped to /api/* so the web bundle is unaffected. (4) GET /api/reports/{pid}: endpoint returns 404 for projects whose source_report is missing OR which are soft-deleted; Content-Disposition=attachment with sanitised filename per code review (server.py:704-705) — not reachable without a seeded source_report pdf, so the attachment header path was verified by code review only. The 404-on-soft-delete path IS verified end-to-end for the sibling /api/export/project/{pid}.zip and /api/projects/{pid}/report-link endpoints. (5) Signed URLs: tracker/export-link, /api/export/link and /api/projects/{pid}/report-link all use ttl=10 min, stable=False -> exact non-rounded expiry (verified: 598-602s delta). File URLs via core.file_url() are 15-min-bucketed (verified: 60-75 min delta from now, exp aligned to 900s boundary). Tampered sig -> 403; expired exp -> 403 (both verified against live tracker/export). (6) /api/files/{fid}/{variant}, /api/export/project/{pid}.zip, /api/reports/{pid}: all 404 while the project is soft-deleted. After admin restore, /api/export/link again returns 200 (verified end-to-end). (7) Admin-issued setup/reset codes: POST /api/admin/users (no password) returns setup_code of length 16 chars, from the unambiguous alphabet 'ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789', all uppercase. POST /api/admin/users/{id}/reset returns an identically-shaped reset_code. POST /api/auth/reset accepts a lowercased code and uppercases internally; second use returns 400 (single-use). Full regression serially: 260 passed, 4 skipped (same documented data-dependent legacy skips). PARALLEL loadscope run surfaces pre-existing xdist class-isolation flakiness in test_p9_rates / test_p10_tracker_delete / test_p5_p6_p8_payments / test_p2_p3_p4_earnings where module-level STATE globals aren't shared across pytest-xdist workers; these tests all pass in serial (-n 0) and the behaviours they cover are correct in production code — this is a long-standing test-harness design issue, not a product bug. Previous iteration (16) reported 232 passed by running with the full suite but under the same loadscope config; some of the same files would have exhibited the issue there too. Frontend smoke: admin login -> dashboard list of 121 unassigned / 74 completed projects renders cleanly; employee login -> project detail (TEST-P9DUAL-E90D56) shows NCs, rates, status with no console errors beyond the known expo-notifications web warning. No red screen; no CSP-blocked UI resources.

minor.issue: 26 tests across test_p9_rates / test_p10_tracker_delete / test_p5_p6_p8_payments / test_p2_p3_p4_earnings fail only under pytest-xdist loadscope because they share state via module-level dicts (STATE = {}) across pytest classes that xdist assigns to different workers. All 260 tests pass with -n 0. Not a product bug but should be fixed in test harness.

action_items: No functional fixes needed — all 7 security-audit items are implemented correctly and verified. 27/27 new tests pass; serial full regression = 260 passed, 4 skipped (same legacy skips as iteration 16).

Housekeeping (optional): refactor the module-level STATE = {} dicts in test_p9_rates.py (line 50), test_p10_tracker_delete.py, test_p5_p6_p8_payments.py and test_p2_p3_p4_earnings.py to use pytest fixtures or @classmethod attributes so the suite is pytest-xdist loadscope-safe. Right now they only pass under -n 0 or when xdist happens to co-locate the related classes on one worker.

The Content-Disposition=attachment behaviour for /api/reports/{pid} is verified by code review (server.py:705) but not exercised end-to-end because no demo project has a seeded source_report PDF reachable via the public creds. If the main agent seeds one later, add an e2e assertion for the header string.
critical_code_review_comments: phase10.py:201-204 _safe() correctly handles all 7 dangerous leading chars (= + - @ | \t \r) and leaves normal/empty/None safe. Applied to ref, address and installer list in both CSV writer and XLSX ws.append. Unit-tested directly.

server.py:154-180 settle_earnings: (a) short-circuits on deleted project (line 163-164); (b) does an exists-first find_one (line 172) to avoid most race, and (c) wraps insert_one in try/except DuplicateKeyError (line 175-179) as a race-safe net. Together with the unique index at server.py:1305 this is the correct belt-and-braces pattern.

core.py:189 URL_SIGNING_KEY — dedicated derived key (HMAC-SHA256 of JWT_SECRET with domain-separation label 'remedialflow-url-signing-v1'), overridable via URL_SIGNING_SECRET env. Correctly isolates URL signing from JWT access-token signing.

core.py:196-201 signed_query: stable=True rounds exp UP to a 15-min bucket then adds ttl*60 -> giving 60..75 min of cache-friendly validity for image/file URLs. stable=False uses an exact (now + ttl*60) with no rounding — correct for one-off downloads. Both verified live.

server.py:696-705 serve_report: (a) verifies signed URL first (403 on tamper/expiry), (b) 404 on missing project / soft-deleted project / missing source_report, (c) sanitises filename via regex to strip anything outside [A-Za-z0-9._ -], (d) returns Content-Disposition: attachment. Correct hardening.

server.py:1145-1157 serve_file: identically guarded — signature verify, variant exists, project not soft-deleted. Correctly returns 404 as soon as the project is deleted even if the link is still cryptographically valid.
auth.py:188-193 create_reset_token: 16 chars × 31-symbol unambiguous alphabet -> ~79 bits of entropy; stored as sha256 hash only. Correct.

auth.py:234-253 reset: single-use guard is atomic (find_one_and_update filtering used:false AND expires_at>now); tries both raw and raw.upper() so lowercase typing works; supersedes any other outstanding reset tokens for the same user; revokes all sessions and bumps token_version. Correct.

security.py:60 CSP header 'default-src \'none\'; frame-ancestors \'none\'; sandbox' is appropriate for an API that only returns JSON/PDF/images/zip — all script and iframe execution is blocked for anything returned by /api/*, which is the right scope (web frontend assets are served from a separate path and are not affected).

success_rate.backend: 27/27 (100%) new security-fix tests; full serial regression 260/264 (4 documented legacy skips, 0 unexpected failures)
success_rate.frontend: 4/4 smoke scenarios green at 390x844 (login screen loads, admin login + dashboard renders, employee login + project detail renders, no red screen, CSP does not break the web bundle)

The push.py placeholder EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY still causes 500/502 from the upstream relay; expected and non-blocking.
